# Business Goals and Business Requirements

## Business goals

### GOAL-001 — Users regain account access without help-desk involvement

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | Approved |
| Scope | In scope |
| Confidence | Confirmed |
| Priority | High |
| Priority basis | Confirmed — SRC-001 section 1 |
| Evidence | SRC-001 |
| Related stakeholder | Fixture owner |
| Measure | Share of password resets completed without a help-desk ticket, % |
| Baseline | TBD (Q-004) |
| Target | TBD (Q-004) |

**Description**

Password resets stop depending on the help desk.

**Rationale**

Resets are the most common help-desk request in the fixture brief.

## Business requirements

### BR-001 — Users can reset a forgotten password by themselves

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Status | Approved |
| Scope | In scope |
| Confidence | Confirmed |
| Priority | High |
| Priority basis | Confirmed — SRC-001 section 1 |
| Source | GOAL-001 |
| Evidence | SRC-001 |
| Related stakeholder | Fixture owner |
| Dependencies | None |

**Description**

A registered user who has forgotten their password can set a new one without contacting anyone.

**Rationale**

This is the change the business objective depends on.

**Acceptance criteria**

- AC-008 — A registered user completes a password reset with no help-desk contact.
